invites.create.help.text: The code gives the role (and team) you choose to everyone who joins with it. Guests can join only as players or parents.

invites.created.help.text: Share this code. People enter it under Groups, Join a group.

invites.team.help.text: Players and parents can be put on a team straight away.

invites.max_uses.help.text: Optional. Leave empty for no limit.

invites.revoke_confirm.text: Revoke this invite? The code stops working at once.

invites.error.invalid.text: Choose a team only for players and parents, a validity up to 365 days, and a use limit up to 10000.

invites.error.used_up.text: That invite code has been used up.

invites.error.needs_account.text: This invite is for an administrator, manager, or coach. Upgrade to a full account to use it.
